translation: Ndipo sanachuluke mneneri mkati mwa Yisraeli monga Moshe, amene Yahwe am'bidzi face-kwa-face — kudziwa מאַחַר panı̽m panim: פנים אל פנים — n'chizindikiro cha Chihebri; tinasulira 'chitsanzo pa chitsanzo', zimene zikusonyeza umodzi wa nzeru ndi chikhalidwe cha Yisraeli monga kumasulira abale a Igiriki. Ndikulimba mtima ndi kuphunzitsa anthu zonse izi — monga Tanakh imene Chapata 2 chikudziŵa, n'chifukwa chake palibe mawu ena m'Chichewa amene amawoneka ngati achilendo, koma tanenera zoona za dzina la mnzake.
